articles.title: Across Protocol warns users to avoid app amid reports of drained wallets
articles.snippet: The protocol is investigating a potential security incident affecting its domain, while several users have reported losing funds after interacting with the platform.

articles.title: Bitcoin nears 11-week low after ‘discouraging’ US CPI inflation beat
articles.snippet: Bitcoin and US stocks initially fall after October inflation tops forecasts, with traders expecting a quarter-point Fed rate hike in December.

articles.title: Near AI Breach Exposes User Details and Data From 18 AI Agents
articles.snippet: An SGLang flaw let an attacker reach internal systems and potentially view confidential AI requests, exposing the limits of hardware-backed privacy protections.

articles.title: Decrypt Money Account Gets Confidential Transfers With Solana Privacy Firm Helius
articles.snippet: Helius' Solana Privacy Rings will let Decrypt users send funds without broadcasting amounts, as it grows out The Information Exchange.

articles.title: This Bitcoin Developer’s Idea Would Make Quantum Attacks a Losing Bet
articles.snippet: Cory Fields wants future quantum attackers to post Bitcoin as collateral before touching vulnerable wallets, giving prepared owners a chance to recover their coins and collect a potentially costly penalty.
